Cost: 4,000eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Mall

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

During the Unification War, Militech field-tested “enhanced cybernetic implant combat software.” While successful in small ops, they were deemed too costly for mass frontline use, so Militech confiscated the code. Despite that, it crops up on the black market anyway. If you can afford this soft’, and use it right, you’ll be unstoppable.

Chipware. While installed, the user is capable of using one of the following Cyberware Enhancements: Vulnerability Analytics, Spatial Mapping, Limiter Removal, Launch Capacity Override, or Data Tunnelling. The enhancement enabled is chosen at purchase and cannot be changed later. Only one Combat Software Chipware can be installed at a time, but they can be swapped between with an Action.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Goes in a Chipware Socket: install the socket first, then install this into it.
  • One item per choice, since the choice is fixed at purchase.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
